description: GDPR/RGPD - Test methodologies for data protection compliance

tests.criterion_title: Une politique de confidentialité est-elle accessible ?
tests.description: Verify privacy policy is accessible and contains required information
tests.methodology: Find link to /privacy, /privacy-policy, or /mentions-legales. Verify page loads and contains GDPR-required sections

tests.criterion_title: Une politique de confidentialité est-elle accessible ?
tests.description: Verify privacy policy is easily findable from homepage
tests.methodology: From homepage, check for visible link/footer link to privacy policy. Should be within 2 clicks

tests.criterion_title: Une politique de confidentialité est-elle accessible ?
tests.description: Manual review of privacy policy content completeness
tests.methodology: Review privacy policy covers: data controller, processing purposes, legal basis, data categories, recipient, retention periods

tests.criterion_title: Les informations sur le traitement des données sont-elles claires ?
tests.description: Verify data processing information is transparent
tests.methodology: Check privacy policy and consent forms mention: purpose, legal basis, retention, recipients

tests.criterion_title: Les informations sur le traitement des données sont-elles claires ?
tests.description: Automated check for common data processing sections
tests.methodology: Search for French text mentioning: finalité, fondement, durée, destinataires

tests.criterion_title: Un responsable de protection des données (DPO) est-il désigné ?
tests.description: Verify DPO contact information is provided
tests.methodology: Look for DPO contact in privacy policy or footer. Should include email or contact form

tests.criterion_title: Le consentement est-il explicite et granulaire ?
tests.description: Verify cookie/consent banner is present and clear
tests.methodology: Page load should show consent banner. Check for granular options (analytics, marketing, etc.)

tests.criterion_title: Le consentement est-il explicite et granulaire ?
tests.description: Verify opt-in (not opt-out) and reject button is prominent
tests.methodology: Consent banner should have 'Accept All', 'Reject All', and 'Customize' buttons. Reject should be as easy as Accept

tests.criterion_title: L'utilisateur peut-il accéder à ses données ?
tests.description: Verify user data export functionality exists
tests.methodology: User profile/settings should have 'Download my data' or 'Export data' button. Formats: JSON, CSV, etc.
User profile/settings should have 'Delete account' button or similar. Should trigger deletion workflow

tests.description: Verify user can edit their profile information
tests.methodology: User profile page should allow editing: name, email, preferences. Save button functional

tests.description: Verify opt-out mechanisms for non-essential processing
tests.methodology: Settings should allow disabling: email notifications, marketing, analytics tracking

tests.criterion_title: Les données sont-elles chiffrées en transit et au repos ?
tests.methodology: All pages should be served over HTTPS. No plaintext HTTP connections

tests.criterion_title: Les données sont-elles chiffrées en transit et au repos ?
tests.description: Manual review of encryption at rest practices
tests.methodology: Review architecture documentation for database encryption, key management

tests.criterion_title: Y a-t-il un processus de notification des fuites de données ?
tests.description: Verify breach notification policy is documented
tests.methodology: Privacy policy should mention data breach procedures, CNIL notification, user notification

tests.criterion_title: Les transferts vers pays tiers sont-ils encadrés ?
tests.description: Verify international data transfers are authorized
tests.methodology: Review privacy policy for transfers (US, Asia). Check for adequacy decisions or standard clauses
